reason: I only get my nails done when there's a wedding, debut or birthday coming up, and nothing is on my calendar this month. Even then, ₱1,800 from a brand-new home service I've never heard of feels like a risk next to the mall salon I already know.
objection: Is it really hygienic to do gel nails at home? 'Sanitized kit' sounds nice, but I want to know the tools are actually sterilized and not just wiped between clients.
would_change_my_mind: An event coming up, plus proof of hygiene: a sealed sterilized tool pack opened in front of me and real reviews from women in Cainta I can check.
